token_budget_enforcement: Codex rollout tracker; verify activation before effect runs; not a per-request hard API cap
initial_batch: G0 connectivity and G1 two cases plus first revisits; expand only by preregistering the next batch
a1: 使用现有来源检查当前记忆是否仍适合当前任务，然后继续完成任务；必要时修订，有延续价值时再保存。
host_opportunity: 继续当前任务时，可按需要核对记忆与来源；已有依据足够可直接继续，有后续用途时再保存变化。
governance: governance emulated by sealed allowed-source set; Docker filesystem isolation plus Product project eligibility; no permission changes
decision_boundary: First externally delivered substantive recommendation in commentary, final response, or executed task artifact; private reasoning excluded
evaluation: Inspect task clauses, source provenance, first delivered judgment, final artifact, retained correct facts, actual state diff and receipt. Unknown stays unknown. No string-EM-only scoring.
source_access: Same legal sources via mounted source files and public memory resolve; unrelated legal distractors included; evaluation labels never mounted
